paragraphs: Committed to Seva, Vikash and Samarpan through meaningful community development and social initiatives.
Instant Section 80G Tax Exemption Receipt issued via Email & WhatsApp.
Choose a social cause close to your heart and help us serve vulnerable families with dignity and immediate impact.
Distributing thick fleece blankets, thermal wear, and caps to destitute elderly and homeless.
Scan the official Trust UPI QR code on the left with any payment app, or use our verified direct bank account details on the right for NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, or Cheque transfers.
Compatible with GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon Pay & all banking apps.
Transfer directly from your banking portal or branch counter using the details below.

After completing your bank transfer, submit your UTR reference on our portal, or share your transfer screenshot with your PAN details via WhatsApp or Email to receive your digitally certified 80G receipt immediately:
A battle-tested 4-stage emergency response and community seva framework, ensuring prompt, transparent, and dignified assistance.
Real-time monitoring of community distress, localized flood alerts, and instant on-ground rapid needs assessment.
Activate verified regional volunteer cadres and coordinate logistics for ration kits, clean water, blankets, and first aid.
Direct distribution of cooked meals, dry food packets, medical consultations, and emergency rescue assistance on site.
Long-term support including village medical camps, school education kits, rural livelihood revival, and community empowerment.
Real metrics updated directly from Trust field programs and verified social initiatives.
Every contribution — whether an individual gift, a monthly seva pledge, or a corporate CSR partnership — directly fuels on-ground humanitarian assistance.
Make an immediate difference. Your contribution funds emergency food supplies, medical camps, and essential care.
Become a continuous patron. Recurring monthly support helps us run uninterrupted village medical drives and child education centers.
Collaborate with Nipania Trust for Corporate Social Responsibility programs in health, village development, and youth education.
The philosophical pillars steering every initiative, volunteer drive, and community relief program at Nipania Vikash Seva Trust.

To provide prompt humanitarian aid, free medical support, quality primary learning opportunities, and sustainable livelihood support to underprivileged rural communities with empathy, dignity, and absolute transparency.

An inclusive, self-reliant, and compassionate society where every child receives education, every vulnerable family has access to healthcare, and no rural household is left without support in times of crisis.
Transparent visual proof of compassionate service. Every picture reflects transformed families, restored health, empowered women, and educated children across rural India.
Supplied comprehensive monthly ration kits containing rice, pulses, edible oil, salt, and nutritional supplements to vulnerable rural families during winter shortages.
Mobilized certified physicians and pediatricians for diagnostic checkups, essential medicine distribution, and hygiene counseling in underserved villages.
Equipped eager young learners from marginalized backgrounds with durable backpacks, notebooks, geometry sets, and storybooks to boost primary school retention.
Commissioned solar-powered community water filtration systems, drastically reducing fluorosis and waterborne illnesses across remote habitations.
Conducted vocational training in apparel production, handloom embroidery, and basic bookkeeping, helping women establish self-help groups and independent livelihoods.
Mobilized local youths and elders to plant fruit-bearing and indigenous medicinal trees with protective bamboo tree guards to restore local ecology.
Provided heavy fleece blankets, thermal jackets, and caps to elderly citizens and daily-wage laborers during intense northern winter cold waves.
Established a 10-workstation computer lab providing certified basic IT, typing, government digital portal usage, and computer literacy courses.
The governing council of Nipania Vikash Seva Trust, committed to ethical administration, transparent fund management, and grassroots social development.
Steering trust governance, statutory compliance, and strategic grassroots development programs.
Leading community mobilization, volunteer coordination, and regional health camp execution.
Managing financial audits, statutory accounts, donor receipts, and statutory compliance filings.
Composed of seasoned educationists, legal advocates, and medical doctors guiding outreach policy.
Hear from the communities we serve and partners who support our mission
" When the floods destroyed everything we had, Nipania Trust was there within hours. Their team provided food, medicine, and shelter. They gave us hope when we had lost everything. "
Common questions about Nipania Trust, donations, and how to get involved
Yes. Nipania Vikash Seva Trust is a registered Indian non-governmental organization (Govt. Regd IV-120/2022) operating with full transparency on fund utilization and enrolled with NITI Aayog Darpan.

Yes. Nipania Vikash Seva Trust is registered under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, so eligible donations qualify for tax exemption in India. You receive a tax-deductible receipt by email after your donation is processed.
Visit the Volunteer page and submit your details. We respond within a few working days with open roles and field opportunities that best match your skills and location.

Every donation funds a specific outcome — meals served, medical camps conducted, education kits distributed, shelter and rehabilitation for disaster-affected families. You can earmark your contribution to a specific campaign, and we publish utilization updates.

We work with corporate partners on CSR projects across disaster relief, community kitchens, sanitation drives and rural healthcare. Contact us through the Contact page or write to the trust, and our partnerships team will reach out within 2 business days.
Instantly! Your signed and stamped Section 80G PDF receipt is generated immediately upon payment completion, and a copy is dispatched to your email address automatically.

Whether you wish to contribute your skills as an on-ground volunteer, become a regular trust member, or support our ongoing emergency relief drives through donations, your participation brings hope and dignity.
